p01-small-dog.observed_description: The same bright empty room and light-oak slatted chair as the big-dog photo, unchanged; beside the chair a tiny fawn chihuahua with a red collar sits upright on the wooden floor, the top of its ears just above the chair's seat rail and far below the backrest, much narrower than the chair. One dog, one chair; no people, toys or text.
p01-small-dog.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the dog is whole, clearly a dog and clearly small against the same chair down to 180 px. The ear tips reach the seat line rather than staying below it.

p02-used-car.observed_description: The same blue hatchback, angle, driveway and garage door as the new-car photo; the paint is dull and dusty with no shine, a long pale scratch and a dent run along the front door, the bumper corner is scraped, rust shows at the wheel arch and along the sill, the headlights are yellowed, the windows are dusty and the wheels are dark grey with dirty tires. Nothing is broken or missing; blank white plate; no people or text.
p02-used-car.note: Usable in 3:2 only (declared four_card false). The wear is clear at 360 px and beside the new car; at 180 px it reads mainly as dull paint, dark wheels and yellow headlights, so it is the subtlest pair of the lesson.

p03-used-bike.observed_description: The same red city bike, angle, paving and wall as the new-bike photo; the red paint is faded and chipped to bare grey metal, the handlebar, rims, spokes, chain and pedals are brown with rust, the saddle is worn with a torn corner, and the tires are grey with dried mud. Both wheels are round and it still stands on its kickstand; no people or text.
p03-used-bike.note: Usable in 3:2 only (declared four_card false): the rust and worn paint read as a used bike down to 180 px.

p04-different-bags.observed_description: On the same light wooden table and pale wall, the left medium-blue school backpack is unchanged; on the right stands a smaller bright-yellow leather backpack with a rounded top, a buckled front pocket and brown straps, about two thirds as tall as the blue one. Exactly two bags; no labels or text.
p04-different-bags.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the two bags differ in color, size and shape at a glance down to 180 px.

p05-different-chairs.observed_description: On the same light wooden floor and pale wall, the left light-oak slatted dining chair is unchanged; on the right stands a low, wide dark-green fabric armchair with thick padded arms, a soft seat and back cushion and short dark legs. Exactly two chairs; a strip of window at the far left edge; no people or other objects.
p05-different-chairs.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): a wooden chair and a green armchair read as different at a glance down to 180 px.

p06-small-red-bag.observed_description: The same white hallway, stone tiles and light-oak slatted chair as the big-red-bag photo, unchanged; beside the chair a tiny plain all-red child's backpack with red straps stands on the floor, seen from its side, its top a little below the chair's seat and far narrower than the chair. One bag, one chair; no people, shoes, coats or text.
p06-small-red-bag.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the bag is whole, red and clearly small against the same chair down to 180 px. It is seen from the side, not facing the camera as the prompt asked; the straps still mark it as a backpack.
